personality.description: This person is moderately curious and willing to try new things, but usually prefers changes that do not disrupt a sense of stability. They tend to act spontaneously and flexibly, though their habits can be disorganized and they may forget details or miss deadlines. In moral dilemmas, they usually stay calm, weigh practical consequences, and try to reach a fair compromise, but they will defend their own principles if pushed. In group discussions, they speak in a balanced, straightforward way, listen comfortably, and contribute without dominating, becoming more assertive when they strongly disagree.
